data_terms.use: Local non-commercial research; no raw media, GT or per-frame artifacts redistributed

buffer_units: 30-FPS reference frames, scaled by backend FPS: 30=1s; 90=3s
design: Fixed five-profile sensitivity study; profiles frozen before any tracker run on this group. Activation-only control preserves .6 high-confidence split; coupled lower-gates profile lowers both to .3. One-factor buffer and combined profile separate effects. No adaptive search on results.
evaluation: Same frozen detections and GT-only visibility/order rules as expanded acceptance; whole-sequence TrackEval CLEAR/Identity/HOTA and paired event recovery counts. Report Recall together with Precision/FP/IDSW/IDF1/HOTA, missing endpoints and gains/losses on all qualifying event subjects.
limitations: New sequence group for this project, but MOT17 training previews are not a held-out benchmark test set.
No ReID, detector tuning, CMC ablation, worker IPC or application-default change in this experiment.
Protocol is a locally timestamped record, not an independently registered study.
